resolution.note: Proxy shipped in shadow mode; live haiku probe on subscription OAuth passed, evidence test/claude/fixtures/ctx-proxy-live-metrics.jsonl

title: Run a localhost context proxy in shadow mode that measures what stale tool-result clearing would save
body:
Outcome: scripts/claude/ctx-proxy.ts, a localhost reverse proxy (127.0.0.1, upstream hardcoded https://api.anthropic.com) that passes Claude Code traffic through unchanged and appends shadow-mode metrics (what stale tool-result clearing would save) to .krn/runs/ctx-proxy/metrics.jsonl.
Why: t-mbrjeja proved built-in clearing cannot be enabled locally; operator grant 2026-11-09 "leć z tematem, masz na wszystko zgodę" (lead memory ctx-proxy-credential-grant) allows credentials through a KRN proxy only in this shape.
Proof: test/claude/ctx-proxy.test.ts against a fake upstream (byte-identical streamed pass-through, headers untouched, metrics fields, would_clear, no header values in metrics, production upstream constant pinned) plus one live claude -p haiku probe with a captured metrics line.
Scope: shadow mode only; no request mutation except stripping accept-encoding; not wired into settings or launchers.
